entities.summary: Kaundinya wildlife sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary and an elephant reserve situated in partially in chittor district of andhra pradesh, and partially in vellore district of tamil nadu, india. Koundinya Wildlife Sanctuary is a protected area with roots in Asia.
